name: AETHERIAL WARDING
text: This turning point, any weapon with Piercing 1 that shoots a friendly Warpcoven operative has Piercing Crits 1 instead. Piercing 2 and existing Piercing Crits are unchanged.

name: FATE ITSELF IS MY WEAPON
text: Roll two D6 and set them aside face up. In this turning point's Firefight phase, once the attack dice of a shooting, fighting or retaliating sequence are rolled and before anyone re-rolls, you may swap one rolled die (either side's) for a set-aside die. The swapped-in die is final: it cannot be re-rolled or changed, and it only counts as the success it actually shows. At most one set-aside die per sequence; if the two totalled under 9, the second is lost as soon as the first is spent. Unspent dice are lost when the turning point ends.

name: BROTHERHOOD OF SORCERERS
text: This turning point, friendly Sorcerers' PSYCHIC weapons have Balanced, or Ceaseless instead while another friendly Sorcerer is within 9" of the attacker.

name: SAVAGE HERD
text: This turning point, friendly Tzaangors' melee weapons have Accurate 1, and also Severe while the Tzaangor is assisted by a friendly Warpcoven operative or is fighting visible to and within 6" of a friendly Sorcerer.

name: ALL IS DUST
text: When an attack die would inflict Normal Dmg on a friendly Rubric Marine, that die inflicts 1 damage instead. Committed once the dice are final; it applies to the first normal success that damages the Rubric Marine in that sequence.

name: CAPRICIOUS PLAN
text: At the end of a friendly Sorcerer's activation: it may take a free Dash even if an action it took (Charge) would bar Dash, and/or you may change its order. If a Temporal Flux is due for it at the same moment, you choose which happens first.

name: PSYCHIC CABAL
text: As a friendly Sorcerer activates, it borrows one PSYCHIC ranged weapon or PSYCHIC unique action from another friendly Sorcerer it can see within 9", and keeps it until this activation ends. A weapon the lender already used this turning point is off the table, and the lender cannot use a lent weapon again this turning point. Boons are never borrowed.

name: MUTANT HERD
text: As a friendly Tzaangor activates, another ready friendly Tzaangor it can see within 2" activates alongside it; you alternate their actions one by one in whatever order you like.
